slides.heading: sort()
slides.body: sort() is part of List Operations and Methods. This short lesson gives you a practical Python idea you can understand, try, and reuse in simple programs.

slides.heading: Core Idea: sort()
slides.body: sort() arranges list items in ascending order by default. It changes the original list.

slides.heading: Real-World Analogy
slides.body: sort() is like arranging test papers from lowest score to highest score.
